title: A category with no margin shows $0.00 and negatives a minus
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 50.
  • Have a new category for this test, category B, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix B, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 0.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 60.
  • Make sure tier A's column in matrix B is Same as previous tier.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a part in category A, cost $10.00, priced $6.00 by tier A, and a part in category B, cost $100.00, priced $100.00, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Category.
  2. Pick customer A in the Customer filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Category opens.

Step 2:

  • Category B reads Parts Margin $0.00 ($100.00 − $100.00).
  • Category A reads Parts Margin −$4.00 ($6.00 − $10.00) and Parts Margin % −66.67%.
